description: Reads games_enriched rows for a run, optionally projecting a column subset and filtering with a raw SQL WHERE fragment for analysis-stage queries.
signature: def read_enriched(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str, *, columns: Sequence[str] | None = None, where: str | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame
docstring:
Read enriched rows for a run.

Args:
    conn: An open connection.
    run_id: The run to read.
    columns: Column subset to select; None selects all columns.
    where: An optional raw SQL boolean expression (column references only, e.g. "complexity_score IS NOT NULL") appended after `WHERE run_id = ?`. Not a general-purpose SQL injection surface for external input -- callers are internal modules (analysis, reporting) passing static, code-authored fragments, never end-user strings.

Returns:
    A DataFrame with SQL NULL mapped to pandas NA/NaN (numpy.nan for floats, pandas.NA or None for object/string columns), one row per matching game.
preconditions: columns, if given, are all valid games_enriched column names
where, if given, references only existing column names and is a boolean SQL expression
postconditions: Returned DataFrame's column order matches the requested `columns` order when given, or the schema's natural column order otherwise
SQL NULL becomes NaN/None, never 0 or an empty string
Returns an empty (but correctly columned) DataFrame for a run_id with no enriched rows

edge_cases.expected_behavior: StorageError naming the unknown column, raised before querying
returns only rows satisfying the expression, correctly combined with the run_id filter via AND

edge_cases.input: run_id has zero enriched rows (enrichment has not run yet)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: empty DataFrame with the requested/full column set, not an exception

edge_cases.input: where references a column not in columns' projection
edge_cases.expected_behavior: allowed -- filtering columns need not be part of the projected output
